A.Ashok vs The Regional Joint Director on 22 October, 2024 
Author: R.Vijayakumar
Bench: R.Vijayakumar
 W.P.(MD).No
 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court
 Dated : 22.10.2024
 Coram:
 The Honourable Mr.Justice R.Vijayakumar
 W.P(MD)No.25080 of 2024
 A.Ashok. ... Petit
 vs
 1.The Regional Joint Director,
 Department of Survey and Settlement,
 Madurai. 
 2.The Assistant Director,
 Department of Survey and Settlement,
 Dindigul. ... Respon
 Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio
 India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus to direct the respondents herein
 conduct enquiry and pass order on the petitioners appeal dated 08.
 For Petitioner : Ms.K.Porkodi
 for M/s.Polax Legal Soluti
 For Respondents : Mr.S.Shaji Bino
 Special Government Pleader 
 1/4
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

 W.P.(
A.Ashok vs The Regional Joint Director on 22 October, 2024 
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64691245/
1

 *****
 Order 
The instant Writ Petition has been filed by a Firka Surveyor working under the second respondent herein, seeking mandamus for expeditious disposal of the appeal pending before the first respondent. 
2. The second respondent, by order dated 08.04.2024, has revised the seniority list, wherein the petitioner was brought down in the seniority. 
Challenging the said order, the petitioner has filed appeal before the first respondent on 17.05.2024 and since the appeal is yet to be disposed of, the instant Writ Petition has been filed. 
3. Considering the abovesaid facts, the first respondent is directed to dispose of the appeal filed by the petitioner on 17.05.2024 on merits and in accordance with law within a period of 12 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis This Writ Petition is disposed of, with above directions. No costs.
